task.description: Diagnose root cause of TC-EXP-402-02 failure: PostgreSQL 42P18 — could not determine data type of parameter $2 — in markRestoredOrphanInTx (src/engine/reconstruction.zig).

result.summary: Category A — Logic error. Source is wrong; test is correct. Root cause confirmed: src/engine/reconstruction.zig function markRestoredOrphanInTx (line ~317) passes $2 to jsonb_build_object without an explicit type cast. jsonb_build_object signature is (variadic 'any') — PostgreSQL cannot infer the type of $2 at prepare time, raising 42P18. Fix: change $2 to $2::text. Incidental finding: lint_sql_param_types.py does not detect 42P18 (variadic-any context) — registered as ISS-0632.

issues.description: ISS-0120 root cause confirmed. File: src/engine/reconstruction.zig, function markRestoredOrphanInTx (~line 317). SQL: UPDATE instance_projections SET status = 'RESTORED_ORPHAN', error_detail = jsonb_build_object('restored_orphan_reason', $2), updated_at = NOW() WHERE instance_id = $1::uuid. Parameter $2 (reason: []const u8) is passed to jsonb_build_object() which has signature (variadic 'any'). PostgreSQL cannot infer the type → 42P18 at prepare time. Fix: change $2 to $2::text.

Incidental finding: lint_sql_param_types.py has a coverage gap — it does not detect the 42P18 pattern (untyped parameter used inside a variadic-any function like jsonb_build_object, format, row). It only covers C42883 patterns (col::text = $N asymmetric cast). Registered as ISS-0632 / filed on GitHub for later fix.
